description: The Gambia - Solar Radiation Measurement Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Environment, Measurement stations", published or maintained by CSP Services GmbH (World Bank Group). Data repository for solar and meteorological ground measurements from a network of weather stations in West Africa. The data is provided in the framework of the West African Power Pool project: "Solar Development in Sub-Saharan Africa - Solar resource measurement campaign in West Africa”. Funding is provided by World Bank. Coverage: Gambia. It has 6 files in PDF, XLS, CSV. The portal files it under Environment, Measurement stations, Solar. The portal gives 2024 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
